facts.text: Serve the buns when Po tries to fit them all in his mouth.
facts.why: The Kung Fu Panda fandom page on Mr Ping notes Po seen with a mouth full of bean buns in the second film, so the buns gag is real even though it is not in the dialogue.

facts.text: Mr Ping swears there's no secret ingredient.
facts.why: In this film Mr Ping tells Po the story of the Secret Ingredient Soup. The no secret ingredient gag is from the first film.
facts.fix: Mr Ping's Secret Ingredient Soup, no peeking.

vibe.verdict: Mr. Ping's shop is the right place and the radish crate and Shen's fireworks are good picks, but a couple of jokes lean on the first film.
